messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["goat", "tortoise"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A four-legged shaggy brown goat-like creature standing in side view facing right, with a domed tortoise-like shell on its back and tortoise-like scaly armor on its shoulders, hips and legs. It has a bearded goat head with curved ridged horns, pointed ears, a long furry neck, a fur-covered barrel torso, four furry legs ending in cloven hooves, and a short fluffy tail at the rear. The back shell and body patches are made of brown polygonal scutes with growth rings.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "a furry brown goat head with long muzzle, dark eye, nostril and mouth", "part": "head", "where": "at the front top of the body on a long furry neck"}, {"looks_like": "curved ridged brown goat horns", "part": "horns", "where": "on top of the head pointing up and back"}, {"looks_like": "pointed furry goat ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on the sides of the head below the horns"}, {"looks_like": "long hanging hairy goat beard", "part": "beard", "where": "under the chin and along the throat"}, {"looks_like": "long shaggy brown and cream goat fur", "part": "body fur", "where": "covering the neck, torso and upper parts of the legs"}, {"looks_like": "furry goat legs partly covered in scaly armor", "part": "legs", "where": "four legs extending down from the torso, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "dark cloven goat hooves with fur above", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom ends of the four legs"}, {"looks_like": "short upright fluffy furry goat tail", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear end of the torso"}, {"looks_like": "a domed tortoise carapace of brown polygonal scutes with growth rings", "part": "shell", "where": "on the middle of the back over the fur"}, {"looks_like": "patches of raised polygonal brown tortoise-like scutes", "part": "shoulder and hip plates", "where": "on the shoulders and thighs over the fur"}, {"looks_like": "segmented rows of brown tortoise-like scales", "part": "leg scales", "where": "wrapping around the front and hind legs above and below the joints"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
